description: E9all with the policy extended to every send: unconnected UDP datagrams are decided at cgroup/sendmsg4 and, with per_send=1, every send on an existing socket is re-authorized by the BPF LSM program on socket_sendmsg. Otherwise identical to E9all (session identity, clearing, send binding, datagram hooks, trusted runtime, policy, live IPFIX, collector fact-all.bt; DNS over UDP, HTTP, and a subprocess connect per call).
